summary.headline: Music Broadcast Q2 FY27 revenue rose about 8% YoY to INR41 crores, while total expenses fell about 20% to INR34.8 crores, turning operating profit before tax positive at INR1.5 crores.
summary.overview: Q2 FY27 revenue was INR41 crores, up about 8% YoY from INR37.8 crores but down sequentially from INR44.5 crores in Q1 FY27. Total expenses fell about 20% YoY to INR34.8 crores, so operating profit before tax was INR1.5 crores against an operating loss of INR13.3 crores a year earlier. Reported profit before tax was INR8.9 crores versus a loss of INR6.4 crores in Q2 FY26. For H1 FY27, revenue was INR85.5 crores (down about 2% YoY) and reported PBT was INR21.2 crores against a loss of INR6.3 crores in H1 FY26. Management attributed the sequential revenue dip to an earlier festive season last year and said guidance beyond the current half is not being given.

segments.name: FCT / Non-FCT revenue mix
segments.commentary: Revenue split is about 80% FCT and 20% non-FCT in Q2. Management said non-FCT contributes 18% to 20% of revenue and it aims to grow this share through concerts and events in Tier 2 and Tier 3 markets.

guidance_outlook: No guidance given for FY27 or the next 1-2 years, citing market and geopolitical uncertainty; management said it will act if the market improves.
Current profitability run-rate is expected to continue, per CFO.
Quarterly total cost expected to stay around INR39-40 crores, based on the last three quarters.
Management hopes for a better festive season this half than last year, but said revenue depends on market conditions.
No buyback plans currently; dividend decision cannot be commented on at present.
capex_capacity: No capex plans, capacity, utilisation, or commissioning timelines were discussed on the call.
Market share reported at 24% (Rajiv Shah); no station count or network capacity figures given.
Non-FCT events strategy: management is exploring concerts and experiential events in Tier 2 and Tier 3 markets, to be pursued only where profitable; no event count or spend quantified.
demand_pricing: Advertising environment described as requiring a measured, client-focused approach; management is pursuing core radio monetisation, strategic advertisers, non-FCT revenue, branded content, events, sponsorships and digital integrations.
Experiential activities and concerts being explored in Tier 2 and Tier 3 markets, where the company says it has strong presence; events to be pursued only where profitable.
Festive season has begun, and management is hopeful momentum continues over the next two quarters.

qa_highlights.question: What is the FCT and non-FCT split and the market share this quarter?
qa_highlights.answer: FCT/non-FCT split is 80:20 for the quarter; market share is 24%.

qa_highlights.question: How much were employee and other expenses reduced versus Q1?
qa_highlights.answer: Total cost was about INR1 crore lower than Q1. Employee costs rose by INR60 lakh, while other expenses fell by INR1.6 crore.

qa_highlights.question: Will non-FCT revenue accelerate in H2 through concerts and events?
qa_highlights.answer: Management is pursuing concerts and events in Tier 2 and Tier 3 markets; non-FCT is 18-20% of revenue, and events will be run only if profitable.

qa_highlights.question: Will the cost-cutting benefit continue?
qa_highlights.answer: Costs have run at about INR39-40 crores per quarter over the last three quarters, and management expects this to continue.

qa_highlights.question: What is net cash, and are buybacks or dividends planned?
qa_highlights.answer: Net cash is INR283 crores. No buyback plans; dividend plans cannot be commented on now.

qa_highlights.question: Can management give directional FY27 or multi-year guidance?
qa_highlights.answer: No guidance for the next two years given market and geopolitical uncertainty; current profitability is expected to continue, and revenue depends on the market.

risks_watch: Revenue is down sequentially (INR44.5 crores to INR41 crores) and H1 revenue is down about 2% YoY, so top-line growth remains unproven.
Festive-season revenue in H2 depends on market conditions; management gave no quantified expectation.
Non-FCT share of about 18-20% needs to rise; the success of Tier 2/3 concerts and events is unproven and depends on their profitability.
Dividend policy and buyback plans are undecided, with no timeline.
Management gave no multi-year guidance, citing geopolitical and market uncertainty.
summary.management_tone: Confident on cost discipline and profitability, with the CEO and CFO stating current profitability will continue. Cautious and non-committal on revenue, guidance and capital returns, citing market and geopolitical uncertainty.
key_quotes: So, if you see from last 3 quarters, basically, the cost is around this INR39 crores, INR40 crores for the quarter, and that should continue.
So current profitability, we will continue. Revenue will again depends on how the market pans out.
right now, we are basically not in a position to give any guidance for the next 2 years.
